The company said on Wednesday the investments in robotaxis would largely comprise equity investments in autonomous-driving partners and balance-sheet support for fleet operations and vehicle ‌commitments.  Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, on ⁠a conference call with analysts, brushed off reports of Waymo considering ending their partnership, saying he expected the companies to continue operating together ⁠in Austin and Atlanta, while the ride-hailing company expanded ties with other autonomous vehicle developers.
